description_en: Upgrades a service instance to a new version
kebab_example: aliyun computenest upgrade-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4bxxxxxx --service-version 2 --parameters RegionId_:_cn-hangzhou_,_InstanceType_:_ecs.g5.large --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeServiceInstance

parameters.help_en: The service version to upgrade to
parameters.name: service_version

parameters.help_en: The parameters required for the upgrade. This is used when new parameters are added to the new service version
parameters.help_zh: 升级时所需参数，用于新版本服务有新增参数时
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. It can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. A dry run checks for issues such as permissions and the instance status. Valid values:

- true: Sends the request without upgrading the service instance.

- false: Sends the request and upgrades the service instance after the check is passed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

- true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

- false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run
